OpenMLS AuthenticatedContent::new_external_proposal (openmls/src/framing/mls_auth_content.rs:196 at 24f3eb6) hardcodes an empty authenticated_data, and ExternalProposal::new_app_data_update has no AAD parameter. mls-extensions-10 section 4.9 (txt lines 809-813, 900-904) says that once the GroupContext app_data_dictionary carries safe_aad, authenticated_data always starts with a SafeAAD struct (an empty one is the byte 0x00). So in a safe_aad room (real MIMI rooms carry it; hub/submit.rs:280 requires SafeAAD) every receiver rejects the hub's external proposal: confirmed, check_safe_aad fails with EndOfStream. Observer::propose_app_update therefore fails closed with ObserverError::SafeAadRequired. Options: (A) extend the openmls fork so new_app_data_update (or new_external_proposal) takes authenticated_data, and pass EMPTY SafeAAD 0x00; (B) hand-frame the external PublicMessage in mimi-mls (FramedContent + SignWithLabel FramedContentTBS, RFC 9420 section 6.1; about 30 lines) without the OpenMLS builder. Recommendation: A, since it keeps framing in OpenMLS and is a natural part of the upstream report.
